messages:
alex (CEO): All-hands Friday 9:30am PT. Quick agenda: 1) Exec update + FY priorities 2) Launch callouts (Dedicated beta + Optimize features) 3) Post-incident learnings + SLA changes 4) HR update (referrals + leveling) 5) Q&A. Add questions here or in the Notion thread: https://notion.redwood/company/all-hands-input. Recording will be posted after.

nina (CTO): Please flag any infra topics you'd like covered (esp. autoscaler and KV cache improvements). Drop 1-line notes below.

maya (VP Product): Slide template uploaded under "Slides -> 1-line updates". If your team has a launch demo, we have two 3-min demo slots. Add demos by Thu noon.

rafael (EngOps): Ops note: we'll summarize last week's latency incident and new fallback policy. If your team had customer impact, DM me so I can include the example.

sam (People Ops): Heads-up: referral bonus increases from $2k -> $3k for hires after July 1. Also rolling out leveling calibration workshops next month. Docs: https://hr.redwood/announcements/leveling-2026.

hannah (Customer Success): Collecting customer questions about Dedicated beta onboarding. If you own a pilot, share contact list w/ CS by Wed.

deploy-bot: Reminder: all-hands scheduled Fri 9:30 PT. Auto-upload of recording + transcript to /company/allhands ~10m after meeting.

[--- meeting happened ---]

alex (CEO): Thanks everyone. Recording: https://redwoodin.co/recordings/1797602468. Short takeaways: 
- Strategy: focus on runtime SLOs and roadmap prioritization for cost reductions.
- Product: Dedicated beta announced (limited seats). Optimize v1 shipping in two weeks.
- Ops: SLA changes: new 99.9% per-route latency SLO for hosted customers, plus automated model fallback.
- HR: referral bump effective Jul 1; leveling calibration process starts July 15.

nina (CTO): Tech takeaway: we merged the KV cache eviction improvement that shaves ~15% p99 on long-context workloads. Will publish benchmark in eng-notes.

maya (VP Product): Launch callouts: Dedicated beta signup form live Monday. If you have launch copy or partner comms, coordinate with marketing.

rafael (EngOps): Incident summary: last Wed outage caused by autoscaler race. Root cause: race when scaling down nodes + sudden traffic spike. Mitigations: 1) temporary cooldown increased, 2) conservative early scaling rule, 3) postmortem in /incidents (link posted).

sam (People Ops): Q&A highlights: 
- Q: Will leveling changes affect comp bands this cycle? A: No retroactive comp changes; calibration is to standardize leveling.
- Q: Can referrals be submitted for contractors? A: Yes, applicable hires that convert to full-time. Full policy in HR doc.

hannah (Customer Success): Customer note: pilots want clearer onboarding checklist. Rafael + CS will draft a checklist template and share with product.

alex (CEO): Action items: 1) Rafael publish postmortem + action tracker by EOD Monday. 2) Product: finalize Dedicated beta onboarding playbook. 3) HR: schedule calibration workshops and invite managers. We'll post a consolidated follow-up doc with links by Monday. Thanks all. :rocket:
